item.description: My Repos Here are some of the notable projects I’ve worked on. These reflect my passion for offensive security, reverse engineering, and malware development. Project Name Description OsXploiter A tool to generate reverse shell payloads with dual-layer encryption for Windows. LFI_Racer Automating LFI to RCE (using different methods such as Temp file injection, PHP info, Nginx /proc abusing…). ProcessHollo-MSBUILD A process hollowing technique in .NET, injecting malicious code into MSBuild.

item.title: Owl & Katana
item.description: The Owl and The Katana: Inspirations for My Journey in Cybersecurity In the digital world, just as in nature, it is essential to remain vigilant, focused, and wise. The owl, with its keen vision and ability to stay silent while observing, teaches me the importance of stealth and vigilance. In a field where information is power, being able to quietly observe and understand the environment before acting is crucial.
